backend: ANGLE (NVIDIA, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 Ti (0x00002208) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)
method: Actual completed main render-list transmission entries. Geometry AABBs are expanded componentwise by the exact shader thickness/world-scale bound; projected without changing viewport. Effective roughness also has a geometric derivative term, so scalar material roughness is not claimed as an upper bound.

haze.method: exponential height haze from scene depth, horizon-lit; the modelled land and sea dissolve into the dome's far field before the far plane and the sea plane's edge

volume.method: shadow-mapped single-scattering march (haze shafts, marine fog, indoor dust), joint-bilateral upsampled

limits: Static opaque geometry and one Lambertian bounce; no dynamic actor/leaf/coast displacement visibility
First-order directional irradiance; sparse moment visibility is approximate and may leak across unsampled thin walls
Material base color/metalness only; texture, vertex color and procedural detail are not baked
Actual sky gradient plus authored far-ground boundary; solar disk/cloud/stars and direct-sun bounce omitted
Final authored emitter-radius segment is unoccluded to model a diffuse bulb within its shade
Bathroom cove bounce uses an equal-energy midpoint approximation; direct lighting integrates the full segments
Transparent, refracted, volumetric and specular transport remain native approximations; no ray-traced caustics
Native direct practical lights remain unshadowed; only cached indirect bounce includes traced visibility
Outside the bounded regions uses unoccluded actual-sky diffuse fallback

coupling.method: Gaussian submerged palm / exponential face drag

caustics.method: paraxial lens of the simulated surface: 1/|det(I + l(1-1/n) Hess h)|, central differences over one cell

stroke.method: prescribed anatomical IK / measured submerged palm velocity

optics.method: Three r164 screen-space refracted background / Beer-Lambert attenuation
